decision: Selected the centroid of the union of Santa Clara County parcels 224-08-139 (situs 1101 SPACE PARK DR) and 224-08-154 (situs 3060 RAYMOND ST) as the campus locator of Colovore's adjacent SJC01 and SJC02 data centers in Santa Clara.

selected_properties.layer: County of Santa Clara Parcels (Socrata ubcd-cewv, FY2026), queried by situs house number and street; exactly these two parcels are returned

computed.centroid_parcel: inside 224-08-139, about 1 m from the 224-08-154 boundary
computed.method: Union of the two parcel polygons; centroid computed in EPSG:32610 (WGS 84 / UTM 10N) and returned to WGS84; an EPSG:5070 cross-check gives the same point; geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid.

identity_bridge: Colovore's 19 November 2024 release places SJC02 at 3060 Raymond Street, 'Immediately adjacent to its first data center at 1101 Space Park Drive'.

The county parcel query returns 224-08-139 at situs 1101 SPACE PARK DR (eight situs addresses) and 224-08-154 at situs 3060 RAYMOND ST, both in the City of Santa Clara; the polygons adjoin and form one 3.44-acre polygon.
Colovore's Silicon Valley market page lists SJC01 and SJC02, both in Santa Clara, as its two active Silicon Valley sites.
unresolved: Parcel 224-08-139 has eight situs addresses, so the parcel may hold other occupants; the building footprints of SJC01 and SJC02 are not located individually.
nearby_records: No Atlas site, project, source record, identity-mapping entry, pending fragment change, claim or hold coordinate lies within 2 km; the nearest Atlas site is the Microsoft Alviso San Jose Datacenter Campus, about 5.8 km north-east.
